deals.comment: Yahoo Japan Corp acquired a 41.70% stake in Brainer for ¥490 million on August 31, 2007.

Yahoo Japan Corp. (TSE: 4689) agreed to acquire the remaining 58.3% stake in Brainer for ¥685 million on February 20, 2008. Yahoo Japan will offer ¥230 per share of Brainer. For the year ended December 31, 2007, Brainer had total assets of ¥159 million. The deal has been approved by the Board of Directors of Yahoo Japan. The deal is expected to complete by April 1, 2008.

Yahoo Japan Corp. (TSE: 4689) agreed to acquire a 51% stake in GyaO from USEN Corporation (OSE: 4842) for approximately ¥530 million in cash on April 7, 2009. Yahoo Japan will acquire 4,998 shares of GyaO from USEN for ¥106000 per share. Under the agreement, Yahoo will merge its Doga contents streaming portal with GyaO. GyaO recorded sales of ¥5.4 billion and operating income of ¥2.7 billion for the year ended August 31, 2008. The deal is expected to be completed by April 30, 2009.

deals.comment:
Kei Shibata, President and Representative Director of Venture Republic, made a proposal to acquire the remaining 89.9% stake in Venture Republic Inc. (JASDAQ:2177) from Taiyo Life Insurance Company, Nikkei Business Publications, Inc., Osaka Securities Finance Co., Ltd. (OSE:8512), Lawson Inc. (TSE:2651), Venture Republic Inc., ESOP, Kenichi Shibata, Hiroyuki Nishimura, Taira Ohnishi, Ryosuke Ito and others for ¥1.8 billion on January 5, 2012. Shibata will acquire the common shares and the warrants of Venture. The shares can be tendered for 30 business days for ¥1,100 each from March 16, 2012 to April 27, 2012. 

Shibata concluded tender offer subscription contract with Lawson on March 15, 2012. Announcement of tender offer launch date is March 16, 2012. In case the program is executed, LAWSON Inc. will tender all shareholdings in Venture. Kenichi Shibata and Hiroyuki Nishimura have agreed to tender their shares. The transaction is subject to minimum number of shares (1.57 million shares) to be tendered. The Board of Directors of Venture Republic resolved and recommended shareholders to participate in the tender offer on March 15, 2012. If all the shares are tendered, Venture will be delisted from the Osaka Securities Exchange JASDAQ Market Growth. The transaction is expected to complete by the end of August 2012. The settlement will start from May 9, 2012. Mitsubishi UFJ Morgan Stanley Securities Co., Ltd. will handle the settlement. es Networks Co., Ltd. determined the tender offer value for Shibata. Plutus Consulting acted as financial advisor and Bingham McCutchen LLP Sakai, Mimura, Aizawa Law Office acted as legal advisor for the Board of Directors of Venture Republic. Mitsubishi UFJ Morgan Stanley Securities Co., Ltd. acted as financial advisor for Venture Republic Inc.
